title: Differentially heated cavity at Ra = 0 (pure conduction: Nu = 1, u = 0 exactly) and at small Ra (Batchelor's limit: u ~ Ra, Nu - 1 ~ Ra^2; circulation sense); centro-symmetry Nu_hot = Nu_cold
physics: Differentially heated square cavity [0,1]^2 in the de Vahl Davis scaling: rho0 = c_p = k = 1 (alpha = 1), mu = Pr, beta g = Ra Pr, T = +1/2 on x = 0 (hot), -1/2 on x = 1 (cold), adiabatic y = 0, 1, no slip, T_ref = 0, gravity -e_y; the hot / cold walls include their end points (corner vertices take the wall value); velocities in units of alpha / L; Nu_wall = q_in / (k Delta T) with q_in = -Q_out the VARIATIONAL heat flux entering through the wall; the case reports BOTH Nusselt numbers, Nu_hot (wall x = 0, heat entering) and Nu_cold (wall x = 1, heat leaving: q_in = -Q_out there too)

parameters.cavity: Differentially heated square cavity [0,1]^2 in the de Vahl Davis scaling: rho0 = c_p = k = 1 (alpha = 1), mu = Pr, beta g = Ra Pr, T = +1/2 on x = 0 (hot), -1/2 on x = 1 (cold), adiabatic y = 0, 1, no slip, T_ref = 0, gravity -e_y; the hot / cold walls include their end points (corner vertices take the wall value); velocities in units of alpha / L; Nu_wall = q_in / (k Delta T) with q_in = -Q_out the VARIATIONAL heat flux entering through the wall; the case reports BOTH Nusselt numbers, Nu_hot (wall x = 0, heat entering) and Nu_cold (wall x = 1, heat leaving: q_in = -Q_out there too)

runs.symmetry: Ra = 1e5, N = 16 and 32, lap and sym, Galerkin and SUPG (the pinned tau family; Ra continuation 1e3, 1e4, 1e5)

unit.construction: scalar_transport_check.box_mesh(8, 8, k), k = 0..4, on [0,1]^2 in (x, y): 8 x 8 squares split along the (1,1) diagonal except the two cells at the corners (1,0) and (0,1) (split the other way: no triangle with all vertices on the boundary), refined uniformly (red) k times (identical to the fixed F1a structured_mesh(N), N = 8 * 2^k). Nested.
unit.h_definition: h_nominal = 1/N (leg of the right triangles); h_max = sqrt(2)/N reported too

parameters.dirichlet_data: P2 (P1) Lagrange NODAL interpolation of the fixed callables at the vertices and edge midpoints of the Dirichlet boundary parts; at a node shared by two Dirichlet parts the data agree (one exact callable per field); Dirichlet beats every natural condition at a shared node
parameters.nonlinear_solver: Newton (exact Jacobian) from the lift, Armijo line search allowed, newton_rtol 1e-12; Ra continuation as listed
